verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no dashboard subscriptions and no alerts or anomaly notifications. The marketing lines about agents that "monitor your product continuously" and about diagnosing what changed "delivered as a dashboard" describe a related insight feature, not subscribing to a dashboard or being alerted when a metric moves abnormally. That evidence is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally
